PS153 · Item glow by meaning.
Proposal entry from source context
Play surface: more to consider › Round 16, 2026-11-15: feel and finish, the Discord features, and UI for what has none › Feel and finish (proposals; polish lane)

Rarity or quality as a coloured name with a soft edge glow; a new item pulses once and keeps a dot until hovered; equipped and favourited items get a mark (☆ as in YAIR). A glow means one thing per world, with no decoration for its own sake.
